paper.title: BreastG-FCL: Graph-Conditioned Federated Continual Learning for Breast Cancer Radiogenomics

unchanged: TCGA-BRCA expression features and prediction target
changed: label-free expression encoder conditioned on a graph row
joint local E/F/G prediction and adversarial training
server graph-row MSE training and differentiable frozen local discriminator
all-task synthetic replay without historical raw-input reads
E/F/G aggregation and per-client optimizer/scheduler state return through NVFlare
global patient-disjoint train/test split before task and client assignment
patient/sample identity audits and rejection of duplicate record assignments or empty client/task splits
expression and TCIA normalization fitted only on final eligible training data, with saved fitting statistics and identities
client-side Laplace perturbation of all uploaded real and synthetic encodings before Collab transmission
primary-breast diagnosis selection from the unchanged clinical JSON, correcting eligible cohort membership and task assignments

learning_protocol.encoder: E(expression, graph_row) -> latent; labels never enter the encoder
learning_protocol.noise_dimension_provenance: public implementation choice, not a reported author setting
learning_protocol.local_objective: current-real prediction NLL minus lambda_gan * graph-row MSE, plus the corresponding sum of synthetic objectives
learning_protocol.server_objective: minimize graph-row MSE directly on client-perturbed real and synthetic latents without adding latent noise again
learning_protocol.latent_upload_noise: client generate_encodings adds independent Laplace noise with scale b = sensitivity / epsilon to every current real E encoding and current or historical G encoding before returning it through Collab; epsilon = 0 retains the existing no-noise mode b = 0
learning_protocol.graph_noise_location: relational-graph Laplace perturbation remains on the server
learning_protocol.simulation_randomness: operation-derived seeds support deterministic simulation; the implementation does not establish formal differential privacy or a production privacy guarantee
learning_protocol.local_discriminator: frozen parameters and evaluation mode; input gradients remain enabled to update E/G
learning_protocol.attention_training: forward only; no separate loss or optimizer
learning_protocol.replay_enabled: synthetic tasks j <= current task k, including the current task
learning_protocol.replay_disabled: current-task synthetic training still updates G; historical synthetic losses are omitted
learning_protocol.historical_label_sampling: sample from each client's saved task label counts
learning_protocol.nvflare_training: one client training task computes current and synthetic replay losses on the same client before returning E/F/G weights
learning_protocol.weight_decay_scope: --weight-decay applies to all client E/F/G Adam parameter groups and the server D Adam optimizer; finite nonnegative values only
learning_protocol.weight_decay_provenance: The previous CLI advertised 1e-4 but neither Adam optimizer used it, so effective decay was zero. The default preserves that behavior; explicit positive values now change training updates.
learning_protocol.graph_conditioning: required for E and G; the unused --use-g-encode switch has been removed
learning_protocol.checkpoint_compatibility: Old label-conditioned E and graph-embedding G checkpoints cannot be loaded directly into the new E/G architectures.

source_reproducible_data_protocol.clinical_metadata: scripts/build_clinical_metadata.py deterministically derives the case-level TSV from the bundled GDC JSON; select a unique exact primary breast diagnosis before reading its stage, retaining missing/unknown primary stages; if no explicit primary exists, allow only a unique breast diagnosis at days_to_diagnosis=0 with missing/not reported classification; reject distinct competing candidates and never borrow stage from a prior, synchronous, subsequent, recurrent, metastatic, or other-organ diagnosis
source_reproducible_data_protocol.clinical_metadata_verification: python TCGA-BRCA/scripts/build_clinical_metadata.py --check verifies exact TSV bytes without modifying the source JSON; rows are sorted by patient ID and diagnosis fields come from one selected record
source_reproducible_data_protocol.main_prediction_input: TCGA-BRCA expression features with log1p values standardized using only final eligible training records
source_reproducible_data_protocol.prediction_target: inherited unchanged from the TCGA-BRCA GFedCL workflow
source_reproducible_data_protocol.train_test_split: group by case_submitter_id globally; --train-split controls the training patient fraction (default 0.8), with remaining patients used for evaluation and no separate --test-split option; proportions are approximate after stratification by Normal-only, Tumor-only, or mixed labels; clinical_stage and random use the same patient-disjoint protocol before assigning tasks and clients
source_reproducible_data_protocol.partition_validation: train/test patient and sample IDs must be disjoint; record indices cannot be duplicated across assignments; every client/task must have training and evaluation records without copying records to fill empty splits
source_reproducible_data_protocol.partition_audit: partition pickle records split_unit='patient', split_protocol_version=2, per-index patient/sample/file IDs, and identity_split train/test patient and sample lists
source_reproducible_data_protocol.normalization_scope: expression mean and scale are fitted on the union of final eligible training record indices after patient and task assignment; evaluation records and excluded unknown-stage tumors do not participate; the same statistics transform training and evaluation data
source_reproducible_data_protocol.expression_cache: schema v3 stores unstandardized log1p values; its fingerprint includes the expression column, gene count, ordered file/patient/sample/label identities, and actual source-file SHA-256 hashes recomputed before every reuse, detecting content changes even with unchanged names, sizes, and modification times
source_reproducible_data_protocol.expression_cache_validation: cache saves per-record identities, source hashes, and configuration; reuse validates metadata, shapes, dtypes, and finite values with allow_pickle=False and non-object arrays; v1/v2 caches rebuild automatically, while corrupt or metadata-mismatched v3 caches raise an error and must be removed before rebuilding; inconsistent gene order across source files is rejected, and complete caches are published by atomic rename
source_reproducible_data_protocol.tcia_normalization: spatial and temporal tables are fitted separately on unique TCIA rows matched by final training records; repeated expression matches do not increase row weight; each table applies its fitted statistics to all rows and rejects zero training matches instead of fitting on the full table
source_reproducible_data_protocol.normalization_audit: partition pickle normalization has schema_version=1 and expression, tcia_spatial, and tcia_temporal entries containing mean, scale, n_samples_seen, and expression fit_indices or TCIA fit_ids
source_reproducible_data_protocol.normalization_timing: statistics are fitted once across all training tasks during local simulator preparation; this is not strictly online preprocessing per task or distributed privacy-preserving statistics estimation
source_reproducible_data_protocol.historical_benchmark_limitations: the external Ray benchmark used expression-file splits with shared train/test patient and sample IDs and full-cohort normalization; its scores do not validate the current patient split or training-fitted normalization
source_reproducible_data_protocol.graph_test_leakage_policy: client/task summaries use training patients only

graph_equations.fusion: G_ij^k = alpha_ij^k beta_ij^k / (sum_l alpha_il^k beta_il^k + epsilon_0)
graph_equations.public_scorer_assumption: GFedCL-inspired multi-head additive spatial attention and query/key scaled-dot-product temporal attention; reference parameterization, not recovered author weights

spatial.encoder_normalization: LayerNorm replaces GFedCL reference BatchNorm to support small client counts

temporal.input: concatenation of the latest m DCE summaries, including the current task, standardized per feature across clients
temporal.early_window_padding: left-pad missing earlier summaries with zeros to preserve fixed m * temporal_feature_dimension input width
temporal.projection_lifetime: the same query/key projection layers are reused across tasks

reference_attention_implementation.fusion: elementwise spatial-temporal product divided by its row sum plus graph_epsilon
reference_attention_implementation.training: differentiable forward only by default; no separate attention loss or optimizer
reference_attention_implementation.learn_entry_point: compatibility inference entry point; epochs is unused; temporarily enters eval mode to disable dropout, then restores the previous mode

contents: state_dict, including DCE history in extra_state
network_config, including dimensions, temporal window, attention temperature, and graph epsilon
checkpoint.interpretation: reference network state, not evidence of separate attention training or original author weights

exact_author_experiment_blockers.detail: The original BreastG-FCL attention parameterization, trained weights, supervision, and optimization are not published. The public implementation supplies reference networks without a separate training objective; it does not recover the authors' learned attention.
The public 91-case workbook contains lesion-level radiomics, not the paper's complete tumor-core, enhancing-rim, peritumoral, and BPE feature pipeline.
The paper does not explain how the limited TCIA imaging subset supplies client/task graph summaries for the reported 1,098-case TCGA experiment.
Exact client count, task construction, patient assignments, split, and seeds for the reported metrics are not published.
The authors' public GFedCL repository omits the TCGA-BRCA implementation.

implementation_validation.scope: Historical author-reported regression validation after review fixes; final refits on 2026-10-10 used the inherited first-diagnosis clinical TSV. These original cohort/results and the paper metrics remain historical; the corrected clinical cohort is recorded separately below.

selected_configuration_final_refits.selection: Three fresh final refits of the previously locked configuration; no hyperparameter search repeated and no outer-evaluation retuning or checkpoint selection.
selected_configuration_final_refits.limitations: One fixed, previously inspected outer split; training-seed variation is not a patient-level confidence interval, and the rerun does not claim exact author-experiment or bitwise historical-model reproduction.

maintenance_validation.scope: Regression and CLI maintenance validation; does not rerun the real-data experiments or CUDA validation.
maintenance_validation.class_width_override_smoke: passed with --num-classes 3, four clients and six rounds
maintenance_validation.whole_example_style_check: passed with Black 25.9.0, isort 5.13.2, and Flake8 7.1.1

cli_alias_validation.scope: Effective --nc/--ni aliases, precedence, invalid class widths and prepared model dimensions; no real-data experiment or CUDA rerun.

clinical_metadata_validation.source_checks: All 1231 raw expression size/MD5 checks and five TCIA artifact SHA-256 checks passed
clinical_metadata_validation.partition_checks: Patient/sample-disjoint train/evaluation; retained records keep their prior train/evaluation side; recomputed training-only normalization and graph summaries match; identical prepared inputs and partition hashes across seeds
clinical_metadata_validation.checkpoint_checks: Distinct fresh initialization and trained weights across seeds; finite checkpoint states and logged losses; no simulator/site errors or warnings; 18 graph artifacts and 30 rows per metric CSV per run
clinical_metadata_validation.selection: Three fresh final refits of the previously locked configuration on the corrected cohort; historical parameter search was not repeated and no outer-evaluation retuning or checkpoint selection was performed
clinical_metadata_validation.limitations: The corrected cohort differs from the historical table; metric differences do not establish a performance improvement on identical data. Previously inspected outer split, only 23 Normal evaluation records, and seed variation is not a patient-level confidence interval. Paper reproduction limitations remain unchanged.
